Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Hallam

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Hallam. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Hallam has a mix of homes, sheds and commercial buildings, and we handle roofs of every size, from a verandah to a warehouse. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Hallam: What We Commonly See

Hallam sits between Dandenong and Narre Warren, a mix of established homes and a sizeable industrial and commercial pocket along the highway and rail line. The older homes have roofs that are now well weathered, the newer builds sit under COLORBOND® steel, and there are plenty of larger metal roofs on the factories and warehouses nearby. Set well inland, the roofs here deal with heat, harsh UV and the south-east's hailstorms rather than salt.

The jobs we are called out for most in Hallam are refixing cracked ridge capping, storm and hail damage, replacing tired guttering, re-roofing verandahs and pergolas, and re-sheeting larger shed and commercial roofs.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Hallam

From a family home to a warehouse, replacing a worn-out roof properly is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof and re-sheet Hallam homes, sheds and commercial buildings in COLORBOND® steel, and we can also build and install flat metal roofing for low-pitch roofs and extensions.

Many older homes were built with roofs that contain asbestos cement sheeting. If that is your roof, we handle safe asbestos roof removal and replacement and finish the job in new COLORBOND® steel. We also convert older roofs to metal with our tile to tin service, and we will tell you honestly which option suits your home.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Hallam

Our registered roof plumbers handle flashings, valleys, box gutters, downpipes and ridge capping on homes, sheds and commercial buildings. On larger roofs a failed box gutter or worn flashing can mean serious water damage, so we trace leaks back to the real source and fix them properly.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Hallam

Your quote depends on what your roof actually needs. Roof size, pitch and access, the type of steel and colour you choose, and how much plumbing work is involved are the main factors. We give you a clear written quote after an on-site inspection, so you know what you are paying for before any work starts.

Our Hallam Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Hallam Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Hallam locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Hallam Roofing FAQs

Do you do commercial and industrial roofs?

Yes. We re-sheet and re-roof sheds, warehouses and commercial buildings, and replace box gutters and flashings on larger roofs.

Can you fix hail and storm damage?

Yes. We fix dented sheeting, damaged flashings and storm-related leaks, and can advise whether a re-roof is the better option after major damage.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.

Suburbs We Service Near Hallam

We also work on roofs in nearby Narre Warren, Endeavour Hills, Hampton Park, Dandenong South, Noble Park and Lyndhurst.
